@lru_cache(None)
def Mz(order,offset):
 power=sig+offset;vals=[]
 if order==0:vals.append(arb('.25')**power if power<0 else arb('3.5')**power)
 for cell in range(64):
  for left,width,idx in [(arb('.125'),arb('.125'),cell),(arb('3.5'),arb('.4'),63-cell)]:
   lo=left+width*cell/64;hi=left+width*(cell+1)/64

Xi=[arb(1)]+[max(rat(max(abs(a),abs(b))) for a,b in controls[i])*4**i for i in range(1,10)]

def pn(sigma,number):
 out=[{(0,0):arb(1)}]
 for n in range(number):
  nxt={}
  for (p,m),v in out[-1].items():
   for j,qj in enumerate(q):
    if qj==0:continue
    nxt[p+j,m]=nxt.get((p+j,m),arb(0))+qj*(sigma-n+p)*v
